qr.title: QR code: {{name}}
qr.unavailable: No QR code for this address
qr.keyNote: Contains a key. Only share it with people you trust.
qr.trust: Only share it with people you trust.
qr.reachSubject: What this code gives access to
qr.reach.terminal: It opens a shell on this computer as its user: the whole computer, with all of its files and programs.
qr.reach.desktop: It opens this computer's desktop: its screen, keyboard and mouse. The same key can open the computer's other programs too, its terminal included.
qr.reach.files: It opens this computer's files, to read, change and delete them. The same key can open the computer's other programs too, its terminal included.
qr.reach.browser: It opens the web browser on this computer and whatever is open in it. The same key can open the computer's other programs too, its terminal included.
qr.reach.agent: It opens this computer's AI agent, which runs commands on the computer. The same key can open the computer's other programs too, its terminal included.
qr.reach.port: It opens the app that answers on this port. The same key can open the computer's other programs too, its terminal included.
qr.reach.alias: Anyone with this address can open this program.
qr.reach.program: It opens this program on your computer. The same key can open the computer's other programs too, its terminal included.
